concept.title: Advanced Overlays
concept.shortdesc: Data-driven overlays that update automatically during a session.

conbody.p: Advanced Overlays are template-based graphics—lower thirds, score bugs, countdown timers, alert banners—that bind to live data sources such as a clock, a manually-triggered counter, or an incoming webhook, instead of being static images.
Overlay templates are edited in a visual layout tool and can be reused across scenes, with per-scene overrides for the bound data source.
